title: AnyUp: Universal Feature Upsampling
mechanism: Encoder-agnostic, image-guided local-window attention upsampler that lifts any feature map to any resolution without retraining per encoder.
adaptation: Upsample frozen or LoRA DINOv3 ViT-S/L patch-16 tokens (32x32 at 512 px) to 512x512 using the 1-channel EL cell (replicated to 3) as guidance, then a light conv head plus a full-res conv stem; no upsampler training, so a probe costs hours. Targets the E1 context gap by making ViTs usable for 1-2 px cracks and gridline.
min_experiment: Frozen DINOv3 ViT-S/16 and ViT-L/16 1x1 probe over 24 classes: bilinear-512 vs bilinear-1024-input (existing ViT-S crack AP 0.212) vs AnyUp-512; metric F51 + module-grouped CV crack AP and gridline AP. Kill if AnyUp at 512 does not beat bilinear at 1024 input on crack AP. Pass leads to a fine-tuned ViT-L + AnyUp arm vs house PF, kill if E1 crack relF1@2 gain < +0.03.
evidence: R: linear probe on DINOv2 ViT-S, 448 px: ADE20k mIoU 40.54 bilinear -> 42.43; COCO 59.48 -> 62.16; VOC 81.43 -> 84.00; best feature-space preservation (ADE20k 40.83 with pre-trained probes vs LoftUp 4.27). E: our DINOv3 ViT-S/16 probe crack AP 0.147 at 512 vs 0.212 at 1024 px, so token resolution limits ViTs here.
prior_overlap: Foundation-encoder row tested frozen linear probes with bilinear upsampling only and no ViT fine-tune; upsamplers untested. Open.

alt_notes.adaptation: Second zero-shot arm beside NAF on frozen DINOv3 features of 512 px EL cells (1-ch replicated); output feeds a conv head plus a full-resolution conv stem for 1 to 2 px cracks and gridline.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Same probe as NAF: AnyUp 512 vs bilinear 512 / 1024 on frozen DINOv3 ViT-S and ViT-L; metric F51 + CV crack AP and gridline AP; kill if not above bilinear-1024 crack AP. About 2 GPU-h.
